items.question: Which goddess receives the final offering of lajjā and the ṭha pair?
premises: The verse names bhagavatī as recipient.
The verse names śāradā as recipient.
The final items are lajjā and ṭha-pair.
items.inference: The verse identifies the goddess and the final items offered.
uncertainties: The ritual function of lajjā and the ṭha-pair is not specified.
items.plain_english: To the goddess Śāradā, and at the end, lajjā and the ṭha pair.
